##  TheRa 3D ( _Thee-Ra_ )

___

feeling fantasy? otherworldly today? download TheRa 3D and be something else today!
this resource pack contains Third Dimensional Models(3D) for items and some entitys model


this project originally for personal used and for fun
I would like to share this project with everyone                  
and please Join discord server for no reason!

required **[ETF] Entity Texture Features** for trident and arrows       
only recommend to be used at the latest version

TheRa 3D is "work in progress" and may have a name change in the future.         
TheRa 3D are not in the same universe as Minecraft.
